purpose: Current public Cloudflare JavaScript/TypeScript SDK and declaration inputs relevant to F# + Fable bindings generated by Xantham. Future Clef to JSIR is a separate horizon.

scope.discovery: Current primary Cloudflare documentation, official GitHub manifests/repositories and live npm metadata; old twelve-project verification harness is not the inventory boundary.
scope.completeness: Broad current documented SDK inventory, including client/mobile and adjacent runtime packages for explicit disposition. Not a claim to enumerate every Cloudflare-owned npm utility, private package, CLI, native-language SDK, transitive dependency or remotely hosted MCP server.
coverage_unit: exported subpath and conditional type target
limitations: Manifest entrypoints are captured exactly; wildcard export targets and transitive declaration dependencies need expansion during generation.
Package metadata and docs were inspected, but each package has not been installed, generated or runtime-tested in this inventory task.
Latest tags may not form a mutually compatible dependency set.
No legacy generated artifact failures are attributed to current Xantham.
Type-target counts mean explicit manifest declarations. TypeScript can resolve adjacent declarations for JS export targets; a lower explicit count must not be treated as absent SDK types.

passing_fixture_pin_reported_by_root.status: Root reports normal-core generation and .NET compilation passed, and generated Body.bytes to actual BAREWire passed 11 Node Fetch checks. This inventory did not rerun those checks.
passing_fixture_pin_reported_by_root.separate_unresolved_gate: Root reports Full-Ship core compilation has an alias-ownership/globalThis cycle; not established as an SDK defect.

findings.text: Workers AI provider 4 and AI Gateway provider 4 target AI SDK 7; current AI Search provider 0.1.1 targets AI SDK 6. AI Search documentation uses Workers AI provider 3 for that combined profile.
Computer and Sandbox dependencies on capnweb ^0.8 do not accept latest capnweb 0.12; retain dependency-specific versions instead of forcing one latest version.
Browser MCP docs describe 1.1.1, but registry latest is 0.0.5 with older Agents and Playwright dependency ranges.
Some RealtimeKit quickstart names are absent from registry; SDK selection names actual core and UI packages.
Agents 0.22.0 has 37 manifest export entries, of which 36 have explicit declaration targets; tsconfig is not an SDK type entrypoint. Root-only generation misses separately exported surfaces.

Current Sessions guide imports agents/experimental/memory/utils/compaction-helpers, whereas the manifest exports the utils barrel. Verify public import resolution rather than treating documentation imports as package exports.

Codemode Vite integration supplies the CodemodeRuntime Worker export. Generated Fable consumers must retain required runtime classes/exports and binding configuration; declarations alone do not implement SDK behavior.
Computer is a published preview; source-only private sibling packages must not be counted as independent installable SDKs.
